name: Taylor Vargas
life: “I still remember a long talk held beside a motionless crane.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the public end of the South Shore boardwalk, where Taylor checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I worked through a break nobody signed for. Three people remember the conversation we had instead of eating.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an unlined tan jacket and a small enamel bird on the lapel. Taylor has fine brows over wide-set eyes, with short copper curls. Taylor draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first during a conversation.
personality: Taylor keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Taylor wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To get the worked break acknowledged.
family: Dale Zhou is Taylor’s cousin. Taylor calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Dale leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The hospital radio*, Dale says, “I found a folded list of songs behind the battery cover.”
connections: Amanda Wong. A missed break can be added to the union tally before the sheet leaves the room.

reactions.response: Taylor asks that the offer be written down with the remaining unpaid hours.
